2610.08300.title: Memory Depth and Reconstructed Context Width: A Controlled Evaluation of Hierarchical Retrieval
2610.08300.paper_summary: Long-term conversational memory is becoming an integral component of modern LLM systems. Proposed architectures group records by topics and events, construct hierarchies and graphs, and connect facts through causal and temporal relations. We experimentally study the interaction between two memory parameters: structural depth and the width of context supplied to the answer model. Using EverMemBench, we evaluate depths D1-D4, core budgets of 1,024/2,048/4,096 tokens, and additional Production and Oracle conditions up to the full archive. Increasing width from 1K to 4K improves Accuracy by 10.11-17.98 percentage points, whereas increasing depth provides no monotonic gain. Beyond 8-16K, Production performance reaches a plateau while tokens per correct answer continue to increase; Oracle preserves quality on full archives of 68-71K tokens. These results motivate further investigation of large, coherent context blocks instead of progressively deeper memory structures.
2610.08300.paper_summary_zh: 長期對話記憶正成為現代大型語言模型系統的一個重要組成部分。提議的架構通過主題和事件對記錄進行分組，構建層次結構和圖形，並通過因果和時間關係連接事實。我們實驗性地研究了兩個記憶參數之間的互動：結構深度和提供給答案模型的上下文寬度。使用 EverMemBench，我們評估了深度 D1-D4，核心預算為 1,024/2,048/4,096 個標記，以及額外的生產和 Oracle 條件，直到完整的檔案。將寬度從 1K 增加到 4K 可以提高準確率 10.11-17.98 個百分點，而增加深度則沒有提供單調增益。在 8-16K 以上，生產性能達到平臺，而每個正確答案的標記數量繼續增加；Oracle 在完整的 68-71K 標記檔案上保持質量。這些結果促使我們進一步調查大型、一致的上下文塊，而不是逐步更深的記憶結構。
2610.08300.author: Michael Andreev et.al.
